name: AI Social Posts
description: Provides a content entity type for managing social media posts across multiple platforms.

suggests.drupal/analyze: Provides text analysis capabilities for content
suggests.drupal/analyze_ai_brand_voice: AI-powered brand voice analysis for content

project_description: AI Social Posts provides a flexible framework for creating and managing AI-assisted social media content across multiple platforms. It adds a fieldable ai_social_post content entity whose bundles (one per platform, supplied by submodules) carry platform-tuned prompt defaults and character limits. Editors draft platform-specific variations of a node's content directly from an "AI Social Posts" tab, refine the text with the CKEditor AI Agent (Make Longer, Simplify, summarize, continue writing), and store the finished copy for use on each network. It is part of the DXPR marketing CMS toolkit and ships submodules for X, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Articles, Facebook, Reddit, Medium, Substack, Bluesky, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Instagram Story, TikTok, Hacker News, a newsletter channel, and an example scaffold.
